EXT.evidence: Gives straightforward replies about uncertainty without showing either outgoing energy or reserved withdrawal.

AGR.evidence: Openly admits not knowing what to do and acknowledges limited chef experience, showing straightforwardness and humility rather than boastfulness.

CON.evidence: Says not knowing what to do is the main issue, but there is no concrete behavior indicating either organized efficiency or careless sloppiness.

NEU.evidence: Expresses uncertainty about life direction and self-deprecates about ability (“only an all‑toast restaurant”), suggesting insecurity.

OPN.evidence: When presented with a new opportunity (head chef), responds cautiously by emphasizing lack of experience and minimizing capability rather than showing curiosity to try.
